Welcome to my portfolio for **MUSA 5080: Public Policy Analytics** at the University of Pennsylvania.

This site documents my work in the Master of Urban Spatial Analytics program — weekly notes, course assignments, and a final project applying data analysis to urban policy questions.

## About Me

Hello! My name is Michael and I'm a student in the Master of Urban Spatial Analytics Program at the University of Pennsylvania.

I'm passionate about turning complex urban data into intuitive, decision-ready tools that make a tangible impact on how cities are understood and managed.
